pages.title: Lead
pages.text: Lead an ordinary creature and right-click an empty cage with the lead to capture it. Using a lead on an occupied cage releases an ordinary creature and keeps it leashed to the player.

pages.title: Collision & Cage Item
pages.text: A non-player creature touching an empty cage may be captured automatically. Right-click an eligible non-player creature while holding an Iron Cage to place the cage at its position and capture it immediately.

pages.title: Player Entry & Escape
pages.text: Players are not pulled into a cage by ordinary collision. Sneak-right-click an empty cage to enter voluntarily. A trapped player can right-click the cage with a pickaxe to escape.
